metadata.description: Antevo plugins for Claude — connect your wealth, and read the Executive Brief, through private-banker skills.

plugins.name: antevo-wealth
plugins.description: Connect your Antevo Wealth account to Claude — portfolios, net worth, real assets, liabilities, markets, geopolitics and your daily brief — plus banker-grade skills. Read-only with confirmation on every change.

plugins.name: antevo-executive
plugins.description: The Antevo Executive Brief in Claude — today's editorial read on markets and world events, the risk radar and how it has changed, the forward calendar, Antevo's own probability layer, and a plain-language decode. No account required.

plugins.name: antevo-trademark
plugins.description: Trademark conflict intelligence in Claude — screen a brand name across 70+ registers, read who holds a mark and how they file, and check the opposition window in any of twenty offices, including the ones that run it after registration. Screening needs no account; your own watchlist and deadlines connect with a token.
